notes: Standard VAT is 18% for 2025 (PwC Israel). Israel has no investment-gold VAT exemption, so gold bullion and jewellery are both taxed at the standard 18%; silver likewise. Customs duty on gold is not quantified on any primary page opened, so it is null. Dealer premiums: Israel Mint lists bars in USD but no same-day spot could be read on a primary page, so premiums/buyback are null.

sources.name: PwC Tax Summaries - Israel, Corporate - Other taxes
sources.what: States 'The 2025 current rate of VAT is 18%'; customs duty depends on tariff classification and no gold-specific rate is given, so importDutyPct is null.
